Distribution. The species is known from two montane localities (1250 m and 1940 m) in Guangxi province, south-east China.

Distribution and habitat. Vicia liupanshanensis occurs only at elevations of 1900 – 2300 m, in Laolongtan, Daxue Mountains, and Migang Mountains in Jingyuan Countyand Longde County, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region and Zhuanglang County, Gansu Province, in China. It is generally found in alpine scrubs and hillside grasslands. (Fig. 2).
